## 💡 Proposed Feature / Optimization
Describe the architectural feature you want to introduce into the freestanding C-pure core of PowerOS.

### The Problem It Solves
- **What execution bottleneck does this feature address?**
- **How does this optimization improve clock cycle efficiency or binary size metrics?**

---

## 🛠️ Implementation Strategy
Provide a technical overview of how this change modifies the current layout (e.g., additions to `kernel.c`, new parameters in `Kconfig`, adjustments to the memory mapping loop).

---
*All architectural proposals undergo extreme performance evaluation by the founder to verify that no unnecessary bloatware or un-optimized loops enter the master tree.*
